projects.title: IWIQ - Greywater Recycling & Heat Recovery
projects.description: Ongoing PhD research within a multi-partner project on integrated water quality and reuse in residential buildings. I develop the BIM-based pipeline that extracts greywater sources from IFC models and generates routing networks automatically.

projects.title: LIBSMapy - Spectroscopy Analysis Toolkit
projects.description: Contributed at BAM (Federal Institute for Materials Research and Testing) to a Python application for evaluating Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy measurements of cementitious materials: denoising, regression models, element mapping, clustering, and cement-content estimation.

projects.title: Reincarnate - Circular Construction
projects.description: EU research project on circular economy in construction. Worked on brick quality assessment with machine-learning-based crack detection to enable the reuse of masonry materials.

projects.title: Ashvin - Digital Twins with IoT
projects.description: EU research project on digital twins for construction. Deployed the Mainflux IoT platform on Raspberry Pi, connected motion sensors via ESP32 microcontrollers, and built real-time visualisation of transmitted sensor data.

projects.title: IOM-UN - Sustainable materials for humanitarian shelters
projects.description: Site development with sustainable materials for Rohingya Refugee Camp in Bangladesh towards sustainable development goals (UN-SDG). Implemented Bamboo-Jutebag retaining walls and Bamboo-reinforced rammed earth walls for flood-resilient shelters; hazard mapping and risk assessment with GIS maps

projects.title: Predictive Maintenance of Glulam Beams
projects.description: Independent research developing a data-driven LCA approach: a Random Forest model forecasting moisture content and humidity over a 10-year horizon to flag when timber beams need maintenance.

projects.title: Resilience of Critical Infrastructure
projects.description: Team project using reinforcement learning in R to optimise emergency response in Berlin — identifying accident-prone areas and modelling distances to the nearest hospitals across interdependent infrastructure systems.
